items.headline: Middle Tennessee and Western Kentucky meet in CUSA action
items.description: Western Kentucky (3-5) at Middle Tennessee (4-4), Nov. 7 at 3:30 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Rickie Collins' 3 passing TDs help Kennesaw State beat Middle Tennessee 44-28 in Conference USA play
items.description: — Rickie Collins threw for 206 yards and three touchdowns, and Tywon Christopher returned an interception 59 yards for a score as Kennesaw State pulled away from Middle Tennessee 44-28 on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Middle Tennessee and Kennesaw State meet in CUSA play
items.description: Kennesaw State (1-6) at Middle Tennessee (4-3), Oct. 28 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Brown and Bourgeois power Middle Tennessee past Florida International 26-23
items.description: — Terrence Brown rushed for 158 yards and a touchdown, and Dominic Bourgeois made four field goals as Middle Tennessee held off Florida International 26-23 on Tuesday night.

items.headline: Middle Tennessee visits Florida International in CUSA matchup
items.description: Middle Tennessee (3-3) at Florida International (3-3), Oct. 20 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Jon Sumrall, Auburn top trolls from Week 7 in college football
items.description: After the upset, Sumrall was in a celebratory mood, donning a cowboy hat fit for a Texan while striding through the hallways of Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium.
